chunk_map.heading: Test with five users, fix, then test five more

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "When an agent can change the slice between sessions" is the closest; "the slice" is APT101 spine vocabulary earned in earlier module slides (the-outcome-loop, you-specify-it-builds use it) and named again in the sibling closer header, so the arc-earned carve-out clears it. L6 "That is Jakob Nielsen's rule" binds to L4 "run small rounds, and many of them" (immediate continuation); L8 "The five" binds to the header and L6 "5 users".

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no cross-file or positional callback; L4 and L6 name no other file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw" backward reference to a beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "the fix between test rounds stops being the slow part. So run small rounds, and many of them." plus the Nielsen quote at L6 give the slide its own self-carrying claim; not a wait-state.

L1 header "Test with five users, fix, then test five more" matches L6 "fix the design and test five more" and L8 qualifies it; closest to a mismatch is L8 "Two distinct groups means testing each", which refines rather than contradicts the header.

Per-sub-item: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (grep of body: none); no anaphora triple; no self-grading superlative ("best" at L6 is inside Nielsen's quoted sentence, not the slide grading itself); no number plus retraction; no abstraction-noun stack (closest L4 "the fix between test rounds", concrete); no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body view banned_words/ritual_ceremony/leverage CLEAN (0 hits). L4 "the slice" is training vocabulary, not repo dialect; no surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, beat or mood on the slide.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep of body lines 1-9 for "**" returns 0; bold budget is not spent. Closest: L6 quoted sentence is in plain quotes, unbolded.
